item.title: Gov. Josh Stein declares state of emergency as another winter storm approaches North Carolina
item.description: After a winter storm brought ice and freezing rain to central North Carolina last week, Governor Josh Stein has declared a new state of emergency as another round of winter weather approaches the state.

item.title: Snow, hurricane-force winds hit NC coast
item.description: Every county in the state of North Carolina is under a winter storm warning this weekend, but the coast could also see hurricane-force winds at some point.

item.title: Many crashes in Charlotte area amid heavy NC snow, 10+ inches now forecast; Gastonia truck hit by train, several cars wreck
item.description: CHARLOTTE, N.C. (WNCN) -- As heavy snow continues to fall in eastern North Carolina and parts west of Raleigh, several wrecks caused problems in areas around Charlotte early Saturday afternoon. By mid-afternoon Saturday, no snow had accumulated in Raleigh, while the coast and areas just west of Raleigh had at least two inches of snow. [...]

item.title: Snow hits central NC, beaches and coast; emergency crews brace for impact
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (WNCN) — It's starting to snow Saturday in counties across central North Carolina, and first responders and businesses are looking ahead for potential impact on roads, businesses and residential areas. item.title: I-85 reopens after NC crash in snow traps 100 vehicles in Cabarrus County near Kannapolis
item.description: KANNAPOLIS, N.C. (WJZY/WNCN) — A northbound section of Interstate 85 north of Charlotte in Cabarrus County near Kannapolis was a major trouble spot for hours Saturday as snow-covered roads and a crash left about 100 vehicles trapped. item.title: Person County snow started Friday night; Roxboro police warn drivers to stay off roads
item.description: ROXBORO, N.C. (WNCN) -- Person County authorities strongly urged drivers Saturday to stay off the roads as snow fell in areas still recovering from last weekend’s winter storm. item.title: Driver caught at 103 mph with toddler unrestrained during snow in Johnston County: Sheriff
item.description: While snow was falling in Johnston County Saturday, a driver was caught going over 100 m.p.h., deputies said.

item.title: Snow finally starts in Raleigh, with 3 inches in Wake Forest Saturday night; NC snowfall totals reported
item.description: After nearly all of North Carolina saw snow accumulate all day Saturday, snow finally began falling in Raleigh around 8:15 p.m.

item.title: Boy saved after falling through ice on Holly Springs pond; police officer jumped into water for rescue
item.description: A Holly Springs police officer jumped into an icy pond, saving a little boy who fell through the thin ice and into the bitterly cold water Saturday afternoon, officers said.

item.title: Central NC snow moves out by Sunday morning amid extreme cold
item.description: RALEIGH, N.C. (WNCN) -- Saturday's snow event took longer to get to some thanks to a patch of dry air in the atmosphere, but by Saturday night there was widespread snow across all of central North Carolina.
